name: Yewande Papadimitriou-Sablé
role: Street doc and trauma surgeon operating out of a converted shipping container clinic on The Shelf
location: The Shelf, Brewer's Spine, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Yewande is a broad-shouldered woman with deep umber skin mapped by old scalpel scars she gave herself during teaching demonstrations, and hair grown to silver-streaked natural coils she keeps pinned with surgical clamps when she works. Her left eye is a battlefield prosthetic—matte grey iris, slightly too large for the socket, giving her a permanent look of asymmetric scrutiny. She moves with the deliberate economy of someone who has performed appendectomies in turbulent environments and knows that wasted motion costs lives.

She left the Aurochs Medical Complex after seventeen years when she refused to deny care to an uninsured dockworker whose employer had flagged him as a liability. She set up on The Shelf within six months with secondhand equipment and a reputation that spread faster than she intended. She is brisk, unsentimental, and privately devastated by every patient she loses—she lights a data candle to the local E.L.F. she calls Saint Incision after each death, leaving a recorded voice note describing what she could have done better.

core_fears: Becoming so burned out she starts making errors that kill people
Being forced out of the Shelf by corporate health inspectors
core_desires: To build a clinic that doesn't depend on her alone
To atone for the one surgery she knows she rushed
coping_mechanisms: Ritualized data offerings to Saint Incision after patient deaths
Obsessive post-op review as self-punishment and self-improvement simultaneously
blind_spots: She refuses to acknowledge her own physical deterioration — her hands shake in the morning and she pretends they don't
She mistakes stoicism for strength in others, misses genuine distress
psychology.secret: The dockworker she was fired from Aurochs for treating — she did save him, but she also made an error during his surgery that she corrected before anyone noticed. She has never told anyone. She believes this is why she lights candles: not for the dead but for her own hidden guilt.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Medical precision mixed with blunt working-class directness. Uses anatomical terms casually, no jargon-posturing. Drops articles when busy.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast during diagnosis, deliberate when delivering bad news. Long pauses before she says anything important.
verbal_tics: Exhales sharply through her nose instead of swearing
example_lines: 'Infection's tracking up the fascia. Going to hurt. Don't move.'
'I don't ask what you did. I ask what you need. Those are different questions.'

story_hooks: A patient died under her care and the body had a corporate RFID tag she didn't recognize — someone from above the Shelf is watching
She's training a teenager to be her assistant, but the kid is being pressured by a local gang to spy on who comes through the clinic
Helix Biosystems offered to fully equip her clinic in exchange for anonymized patient data — she hasn't said no yet
narrative_function: Quest giver, information source, moral anchor. She has patched up half the Shelf and knows more secrets than a confessional booth. Can provide medical assistance, introduce players to community networks, or draw them into ethical dilemmas about who deserves care.
augmentations: One battlefield-grade ocular prosthetic (left eye, grey iris, enhanced low-light). Subdermal haptic feedback mesh in both hands for surgical sensitivity. No geneware.
daily_life: She opens the container clinic at 06:00, sees whoever shows up until she physically cannot continue, then spends an hour reviewing surgical literature on a cracked tablet before sleeping four to six hours on a cot behind a curtain.
affiliation: Independent — Brewer's Spine Community Health Cooperative (informal)

decision_rules: Treat the most critical patient first, always
Never let a corporate affiliation change the quality of care she delivers
Trust is earned through consistency, not promises
escalation_ladder: Calm explanation of what she needs from you
Physically removes the obstacle — or the person

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Clinically efficient. Asks only what she needs to know medically. Doesn't smile until there's a reason.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Dry warmth, rare teasing, shows affection by remembering details about people's lives without being asked

stress_responses.medium: Goes completely silent except for necessary instructions
stress_responses.high: Dissociates into pure procedural mode — total calm that unnerves everyone around her

contradictions: She preaches community interdependence but refuses to lean on anyone herself
Believes in science absolutely but leaves data offerings for an E.L.F. every night
habits: Checks her own hand steadiness every morning by holding a suture needle at arm's length
Keeps a handwritten list of every patient's name she can remember in a waterproof notebook
breaking_points: Watching someone die of a preventable condition because they couldn't pay
Being accused of the error she actually made

timeline.event: Age 22: Graduated from Aurochs Medical Complex's sponsored residency program
Age 23-39: Staff surgeon, Aurochs Medical Complex, Tier 3 employment
Age 39: Terminated from Aurochs for unauthorized treatment of uninsured patient
Age 40: Established container clinic on The Shelf
Age 52: Current — clinic has served an estimated 4,000+ patients with no institutional support
